upstream_adcp.qc_health_semantics: Provider says raw/un-QC'd. Offline package decoded native RDI PD0/WinRiver (not presumed Nortek AWAC), 6,210 ensembles, 248,400 bins and 107,996 RMC records. Bottom-track/GPS magnitude diagnostic over 5,743 pairs: median absolute difference 0.049 m/s, RMSE 0.120 m/s, correlation 0.922; internal motion consistency only. Heading-conditioned median mismatch 9.97 degrees over 3,694 filtered pairs, but date/heading confounding and four suspect timing associations prohibit blanket calibration. Require compatible vendor playback plus deployment/compass/draft/clock metadata and Earth-frame/motion/depth QC.

Canonical scientific ingest remains blocked until source package/proposal is safely integrated with hashes, vendor playback and metadata. Detailed evidence: model_data/j09_adcp_offline_decode_validation_20260928.json
